## Module Name

Give the proposed module a clear, symbolic name.  
(e.g., `S.EnergyDynamics`, `S.SymbolicTimeWarp`, `S.MulluMeshOrchestrator`)

## Purpose & Scope

- What does this module do?
- Why is it important to Mullu?
- How does it relate to existing modules?

## Symbolic Inputs & Outputs

- Inputs:  
  - Types of data / symbols this module receives  
- Outputs:  
  - What symbolic effects, transformations, or products does it generate?

## Structure / Subcomponents

Optional breakdown into submodules (if known)

## Priority & Readiness

- [ ] ✅ Ready to implement  
- [ ] 🧪 Needs more design  
- [ ] 💤 Concept stage only  

## Notes / References

Add any diagrams, links, concepts, or discussions from past threads that support this module.
